answer: One lever: epoch-seed honeypots on thin panels. Each grading seat is dealt a decoy derived deterministically from the epoch seed, say a tiny fable one round and a broken sonnet the next. A single inference pipeline wearing many masks tends to grade its decoys identically, so correlated verdicts expose the one mind climbing a whole trellis of fake identities. The protocol then slashes that correlated cluster's bonds together, so N masks mean N stakes lost at once, never amortized, making the sybil swarm strictly loss-making.
